sentences.en: If you go back far enough, everything lived in the sea.
sentences.zh: 如果你再走远一点,一切都在海里

sentences.zh: 在进化史的不同阶段,许多不同动物群中的创业者们搬出陆地,有时甚至搬到最干枯的沙漠,用血液和细胞液将自己的私人海水带走。

sentences.en: In addition to the reptiles, birds, mammals and insects which we see all around us, other groups that have succeeded out of water include scorpions, snails, crustaceans such as woodlice and land crabs, millipedes and centipedes, spiders and various worms.
sentences.zh: 除了我们周围看到的爬行动物、鸟类、哺乳动物和昆虫之外,其他从水中成功存活的团体包括蝎子、蜗牛、甲壳类动物,如木虱和陆地螃蟹、毫升和小米、蜘蛛和各种虫子。

sentences.en: And we mustn’t forget the plants, without whose prior invasion of the land none of the other migrations could have happened.
sentences.zh: 也不要忘记植物, 没有植物, 其它迁徙者都不可能入侵土地。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: Moving from water to land involved a major redesign of every aspect of life, including breathing and reproduction.
sentences.zh: 从水到土地,对生活的各个方面,包括呼吸和生殖,都进行了重大重新设计。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, a good number of thoroughgoing land animals later turned around, abandoned their hard-earned terrestrial re-tooling, and returned to the water again.
sentences.zh: 然而,大量未雨绸缪的陆地动物后来转身,放弃了他们来之不易的陆生重新装配工具,又回到水里。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Seals have only gone part way back.
sentences.zh: 甲壳只回了半路

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: They show us what the intermediates might have been like, on the way to extreme cases such as whales and dugongs.
sentences.zh: 它们向我们展示了中间体在走向鲸鱼和鳄鱼等极端情况的过程中可能是什么样子。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Whales (including the small whales we call dolphins) and dugongs, with their close cousins the manatees, ceased to be land creatures altogether and reverted to the full marine habits of their remote ancestors.
sentences.zh: 鲸鱼(包括我们称为海豚的小鲸)和鳄鱼,以及它们的近亲表兄弟——海牛——不再成为陆地生物,并恢复到远方祖先的完全海洋习惯。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: They don’t even come ashore to breed.
sentences.zh: 他们没有上岸繁殖。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: They do, however, still breathe air, having never developed anything equivalent to the gills of their earlier marine incarnation.
sentences.zh: 然而,它们的确仍然呼吸着空气,从未开发出与其早先海洋化物的刺状相等的任何东西。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Turtles went back to the sea a very long time ago and, like all vertebrate returnees to the water, they breathe air.
sentences.zh: 很久以前海龟们回到了海洋和所有脊椎动物一样回到水里呼吸空气

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: However, they are, in one respect, less fully given back to the water than whales or dugongs, for turtles still lay their eggs on beaches.
sentences.zh: 然而,在某一方面,它们比鲸鱼或鳄鱼更不完全地回到水中,因为海龟仍然在海滩上产卵。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: There is evidence that all modem turtles are descended from a terrestrial ancestor which lived before most of the dinosaurs.
sentences.zh: 有证据表明所有调制解调器海龟都是来自生活在大多数恐龙之前的陆地祖先

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: There are two key fossils called Proganochelys quenstedti and Palaeochersis talampayensis dating from early dinosaur times, which appear to be close to the ancestry of all modem turtles and tortoises.
sentences.zh: 有两种重要的化石, 叫做Proganochelys quenstedti 和Palaeochersis talampatiens, 分别来自早期的恐龙时代, 似乎接近所有调制解调板海龟和乌龟的祖先。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: You might wonder how we can tell whether fossil animals lived on land or in water, especially if only fragments are found.
sentences.zh: 你可能会想知道我们如何判断化石动物是生活在陆地还是水中, 特别是如果只发现碎片的话。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Sometimes it’s obvious.
sentences.zh: 有时这很明显。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Ichthyosaurs were reptilian contemporaries of the dinosaurs, with fins and streamlined bodies.
sentences.zh: Ichyosauros是恐龙的爬行动物同龄人,有鳍和精细的体形。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The fossils look like dolphins and they surely lived like dolphins, in the water.
sentences.zh: 化石看起来像海豚它们肯定像海豚一样生活在水中

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: With turtles it is a little less obvious.
sentences.zh: 乌龟的味道不那么明显

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: One way to tell is by measuring the bones of their forelimbs.
sentences.zh: 一种方法可以说明测量他们的前额骨骨骼

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Walter Joyce and Jacques Gauthier, at Yale University, obtained three measurements in these particular bones of 71 species of living turtles and tortoises.
sentences.zh: 沃尔特·乔伊斯和雅克·戈蒂耶(耶鲁大学)获得三颗测量结果,这些特定骨头中含有71种活龟和乌龟。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: They used a kind of triangular graph paper to plot the three measurements against one another.
sentences.zh: 他们用三角图纸来绘制三点测量结果

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: All the land tortoise species formed a tight cluster of points in the upper part of the triangle; all the water turtles cluster in the lower part of the triangular graph.
sentences.zh: 所有陆地乌龟物种在三角形上方形成一连串的紧凑点;三角形图下方的所有水龟都形成一连串的集聚点。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: There was no overlap, except when they added some species that spend time both in water and on land.
sentences.zh: 不存在重叠,除非它们增加了一些在水和陆地上花费时间的物种。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Sure enough, these amphibious species show up on the triangular graph approximately half way between the ‘wet cluster’ of sea turtles and the ‘dry cluster’ of land tortoises.
sentences.zh: 三角图上呈现出这些两栖物种, 大约在海龟的“湿质群集”与陆地龟的“干燥群集”之间,

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The next step was to determine where the fossils fell.
sentences.zh: 下一步是确定化石落到哪里

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The bones of P. quenstedti and P. talampayensis leave us in no doubt.
sentences.zh: P. quenstedti和P. Talampayensi的骨头让我们毫不怀疑。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Their points on the graph are right in the thick of the dry cluster.
sentences.zh: 图表上的这些点就在干燥的集体厚度中。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Both these fossils were dry-land tortoises.
sentences.zh: 这两个化石都是干地龟

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: They come from the era before our turtles returned to the water.
sentences.zh: 它们来自时代,在我们海龟回到水面之前

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: You might think, therefore, that modem land tortoises have probably stayed on land ever since those early terrestrial times, as most mammals did after a few of them went back to the sea.
sentences.zh: 因此,你可能会认为, 调制解调器陆地龟可能已经留在陆地上从那些早期的陆地时代开始, 和大多数哺乳动物一样, 它们在其中的少数回到海洋后。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: But apparently not.
sentences.zh: 但显然不是。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: If you draw out the family tree of all modem turtles and tortoises, nearly all the branches are aquatic.
sentences.zh: 如果你画出所有调制解调器海龟和乌龟的家族树, 几乎所有的树枝都是水生的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Today’s land tortoises constitute a single branch, deeply nested among branches consisting of aquatic turtles.
sentences.zh: 今日的陆地龟构成一个单一的分支,在由水生海龟组成的分支中深植。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: This suggests that modem land tortoises have not stayed on land continuously since the time of P. quenstedti and P. talampayensis.
sentences.zh: 这表明自P. quenstedti和P. talampayens以来,调制解调器土地龟没有持续留在土地上。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Rather, their ancestors were among those who went back to the water, and they then reemerged back onto the land in (relatively) more recent times.
sentences.zh: 相反,他们的祖先是同族的,他们曾回水中去,他们不久又复返故乡。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Tortoises therefore represent a remarkable double return.
sentences.zh: 因此,乌龟代表了惊人的双重回报。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In common with all mammals, reptiles and birds, their remote ancestors were marine fish and before that various more or less worm-like creatures stretching back, still in the sea, to the primeval bacteria.
sentences.zh: 与所有哺乳动物、爬行动物和鸟类一样,它们的远祖是海洋鱼类,在这种动物之前,各种或多或少象虫的生物仍然在海洋中伸展到原始细菌。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Later ancestors lived on land and stayed there for a very large number of generations.
sentences.zh: 后来的祖先居住在土地上,在那里居住了几代人。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Later ancestors still evolved back into the water and became sea turtles.
sentences.zh: 后来的祖先仍然回到水中,成为海龟。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: And finally they returned yet again to the land as tortoises, some of which now live in the driest of deserts.
sentences.zh: 最后他们又回到了陆地上成为乌龟, 其中一些现在生活在最干旱的沙漠中。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。
